source_crosscheck.finding: Declared explicit-user-only research policy and mechanical tool dispatch are separate layers; Realtime branches also separate memory mutation, delegated task, research and session control semantics.

design_change: ChildPolicyEnvelope is retained as a distinct typed binding from HumanIntentDecision and EffectDecision.
Realtime tool classes remain typed separately rather than collapsed into one tool permission bit.
Memory writes require MemoryCandidate -> MemoryAdmission before durable mutation.
Research submission requires ResearchRequestCandidate -> deterministic HumanIntent/Capability/Privacy/Economic admission before external submission.
Delegated child mutation requires exact native actor/task/invocation lineage plus one-shot invocation-bound effect authority.
WorldSlice delegation remains scope-bound, replay-resistant and preserves UNKNOWN/NOT_COMPUTED semantics.
next_exact_gate: Observe one harmless installed native-child lifecycle and effective child policy envelope, then prove deterministic pre-side-effect denial for all mutating capability classes and deterministic ResearchRequestAdmission before any external research submission.
